description: Spec v0.3 section 4.6, confirmed against domains/cos/chief_of_staff.py at origin/main 4f531c6f (scheduler jobs :1841-1894, loop state :887-897). One owner per reminder. The spec's table named B, C, H and reminders; the code also runs D, F, G, I and R, listed here.

loops.name: german_watch
loops.becomes: stops when B3 takes over; its session reader moves into the German activity writer, reading the session's own date, not file mtime

loops.name: build_discipline_check
loops.becomes: unchanged in 1.2: it flags stale guild.design_log items, a different record from MC's update. Its output stays in cos_agenda and the picture may read it.

loops.name: ec2_health_check
loops.becomes: raises E1 incidents through raise_incident (section 4.10); its in-memory one-hour cooldown (:436-447) goes, replaced by the incident dedup_key

loops.name: model_gateway_cost_check
loops.becomes: raises E3 incidents when spend passes the caps; otherwise unchanged

loops.name: reminder_delivery
loops.becomes: migrates with domains/cos/reminders.py into obligations (recurrence once); one owner for every reminder

stores.becomes: the loops' recommendation queue until B and C stop, then read-only history; the ledger points at its rows
